summary: SEC-001 fix validated end-to-end. POST /api/auth/forgot no longer leaks reset_token/reset_link. Response is identical for existing vs non-existent emails (anti-enumeration). Token is still persisted in MongoDB and delivery is attempted via Resend (logs show [email:error] due to sandbox restriction — expected). /auth/reset regression still functional. Frontend ForgotPassword page shows only generic message + spam info box; token/copy/'Imposta nuova password' UI fully removed. All 44 backend regression tests + 1 skip pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1734/L1748: `@app.on_event(startup/shutdown)` is deprecated in FastAPI — migrate to lifespan handlers (non-blocking).
server.py is 1943 lines — consider splitting by domain (auth, discounts, subscription, admin) for maintainability.

Pre-existing test env parsing bug in test_pin_auth_flow.py L19: it reads MONGO_URL from /app/backend/.env without stripping surrounding quotes, so running without MONGO_URL env set raises pymongo InvalidURI. Passes when env vars are exported. Not related to SEC-001 fix; recommend `.strip().strip('"')` for robustness.

ForgotPassword.jsx still imports `Copy, Check` from lucide-react and defines an unused `copy()` helper referencing `result.reset_token` (dead code after SEC-001 fix). Remove to prevent future regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New security test file /app/backend/tests/test_sec001_forgot_password.py covers: (1) no leak for existing email, (2) anti-enumeration equality with non-existent email, (3) reset_token persisted in Mongo, (4) full reset flow using DB-read token, (5) invalid token → 400/401, (6) login regression. Run with MONGO_URL and DB_NAME env vars set (see pre-existing parser quirk in test_pin_auth_flow.py). Resend fails in sandbox by design — inspect backend.err.log for [email:error] to confirm invoke.
rca of the issue: Before the fix, /api/auth/forgot returned the plain `reset_token` and `reset_link` in the JSON response. Any actor who knew (or guessed) an email address could then call /api/auth/reset with that token and take over the account. Fix removes those fields from the response; token is only transmitted via out-of-band email (Resend). Response body is now identical for existing and non-existing emails, preventing user enumeration. Verified via 6 dedicated tests plus browser check of ForgotPassword.jsx UI.
